contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #288: Kadison's similarity conjecture.
Source-fidelity audit of invariant intertwiners and word structure in campaign 9000288; all Hilbert spaces and operators are complex and bounded means Hilbert-space bounded.

definitions.D: II_1 factor generated by increasing unital full matrix subalgebras D_j with sizes m_j tending to infinity
definitions.tau: faithful normalized normal trace on D
definitions.E0: orthogonal complement of C1 in E
definitions.C_u: conjugation xi maps to u xi u* on E and E0
definitions.H_k: E tensor E0^tensor k tensor J_k, J_k=(L2(A0) minus C1)^tensor k tensor L2(A0), with empty tensor powers C
definitions.U_sigma: permutation of tail factors by sigma inverse

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 288 (Kadison's similarity conjecture.; papers: Kadison's similarity theorem through uniform derivation estimates; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/288.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For every k,l>=0, every bounded left-D-linear Y:E tensor E0^tensor k -> E tensor E0^tensor l intertwining C_u^tensor(k+1) and C_u^tensor(l+1) for every u in the union of U(D_j) is zero if k!=l, and is I_E tensor sum_{sigma in S_k} a_sigma U_sigma if k=l. Source: tensors.tex, lem:invariant-intertwiners.

For every bounded G on L2(D*A0) commuting with L_D and every stage conjugation W_u, every H_k reduces G and there exist B_k in B(J_k), norm B_k<=norm G, independent of x, such that G(d tensor x^tensor k tensor alpha)=d tensor x^tensor k tensor B_k alpha for every d in E, every complex x in E0, and every alpha in J_k, with the analogous full-output identity for G* and B_k*. Source: tensors.tex, lem:word-structure.

For scalar slices T of Y that commute with L_D, F(a,x,z)=<T1,a*> satisfies abs F<=norm Y norm a_1 product_i norm x_i_2 product_j norm z_j_2; replacing the first endpoints 1,a* by d,c replaces a by c*d. No bounded-affiliated-operator classification is required.

For every p>=1 and m>=p, the complex multilinear forms on M_m(C)^p invariant under simultaneous unitary conjugation have the cycle-trace forms Phi_pi as a basis. For all m their span suffices. The normalization is the normalized trace.

For each fixed p the cycle-trace coefficients of the unrestricted-variable form F are constant from the first stage of size at least p onward; a fixed coefficient lambda_pi must vanish if 2 c(pi)<p+1, by the endpoint L1 and tail L2 bound along unbounded stage sizes.

For arbitrary tail count n, if a permutation on 1+n slots has no singleton tail cycles and 2 times its cycle count is at least n+2, then its distinguished cycle is a singleton and every other cycle is a pair.

For arbitrary finitely many two-slot pair blocks, disjoint orthonormal label pools isolate a prescribed pairing from every other fixed-point-free matching. Its summed coefficient is lambda M^(r_s+r_t) and the squared product of source and test norms is M^(r_s+r_t). Uniform boundedness for every M forces lambda=0 whenever r_s+r_t>0; surviving cross pairings imply equal source and test degrees.

Averaging G over matrix-stage conjugations preserves left-D commutation, the free-corner commutator hypothesis for G and G*, and the exact compression of [G,L_s] to L2(A0). Source: tensors.tex, lem:free-symmetrization.

Under the source free-corner hypotheses, for every k>=1 and v in L2(A0), norm(B_k(s^tensor k tensor v)-s^tensor k tensor B_0 v)<=2 c_0 epsilon norm v_2, also for adjoints. Source: propagation.tex, lem:propagation.

For L=D*A0, t=1/N with arbitrary N>=2, G commuting with L_D and norm[G,L_x]<=epsilon norm x for all x in every D-corner of trace t, and any centered self-adjoint unitary s in A0, norm(P_L2(A0)[G,L_s]|_L2(A0))<=6 pi^2(1+4c_0) epsilon. Source: tensors.tex thm:free-corner, completed in hankel.tex.

For every irreducible inclusion Q subset P of separable-predual II_1 factors and every nonprincipal omega, there is a matrix-generated subfactor D subset Q^omega free from the constant copy of P. Source: finite-factors.tex, lem:free-position.
For every unital factor P subset B(K), Y in B(K), h>=1, and X in M_h(P), norm[Y^h,X]<=C_fac g_P(Y) norm X with universal C_fac. Source: global.tex, prop:factor-representations.

There is a universal constant C such that every concrete von Neumann algebra M subset B(H), Y in B(H), h>=1, and X in M_h(M) satisfy norm[Y^h,X]<=C sup_{a in M, norm a<=1} norm[Y,a] norm X. Source: introduction.tex thm:universal and global.tex.
For every unital C*-algebra A, unital *-representation sigma, and bounded sigma-derivation Delta, norm Delta_cb<=C norm Delta and Delta is implemented. Source: global.tex prop:all-derivations.
Every bounded unital homomorphism from a unital C*-algebra into B(H), for arbitrary H, is similar by a bounded invertible operator to a *-homomorphism. Source: thm:similarity.

For every p>=1 and m>=p, the complex multilinear forms on M_m(C)^p invariant under simultaneous unitary conjugation have the cycle-trace forms Phi_pi as a basis. For all m their span suffices. The normalization is the normalized trace.

external_assumptions.statement: The permutation algebra and the algebra spanned by u^tensor p, u in U(m), are mutual commutants; the permutation representation is faithful when m>p.

claims.natural_statement: The arbitrary-degree algebraic support-elimination core specified in statement_fidelity.md holds: complex matrix-unit product and normalized trace formulas, uniqueness of probe successors, the cycle-length threshold, disjoint two-slot tag isolation and its Kronecker support product, independent assignment counts, coefficient vanishing for arbitrary unbounded natural size sequences, and equal side cardinalities for cross involutions. This claim does not assert an operator-algebra classification.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace InvariantIntertwiners

theorem matrix_unit_product {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (i j k l : I) :
    Matrix.single i j (1 : ℂ) * Matrix.single k l 1 =
      if j = k then Matrix.single i l 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : j = k
  · subst k
    simp
  · simpa [h] using
      (Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne i j k h (1 : ℂ) :
        Matrix.single i j (1 : ℂ) * Matrix.single k l 1 = 0)

theorem normalized_matrix_unit_trace {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (i j : I) :
    Matrix.trace (Matrix.single i j (1 : ℂ)) / (Fintype.card I : ℂ) =
      if i = j then 1 / (Fintype.card I : ℂ) else 0 := by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp
  · simp [h, Matrix.trace_single_eq_of_ne h]

theorem probe_successor_unique {S I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (embed : S → I) (hembed : Function.Injective embed)
    (p q : Equiv.Perm S)
    (hproduct : ∀ i,
      Matrix.single (embed i) (embed (p i)) (1 : ℂ) *
        Matrix.single (embed (q i)) (embed (p (q i))) 1 ≠ 0) :
    p = q := by
  ext i
  apply hembed
  by_contra h
  exact hproduct i
    (Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne (embed i) (embed (p i))
      (embed (q i)) h (1 : ℂ))

theorem cycle_lengths_forced {t n r : ℕ} (lengths : Fin t → ℕ)
    (hroot : 1 ≤ r) (htails : ∀ i, 2 ≤ lengths i)
    (htotal : r + ∑ i, lengths i = n + 1)
    (hthreshold : n + 2 ≤ 2 * (t + 1)) :
    r = 1 ∧ ∀ i, lengths i = 2 := by
  have hsum : 2 * t ≤ ∑ i, lengths i := by
    calc
      2 * t = ∑ _i : Fin t, 2 := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ i, lengths i := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => htails i
  have hr : r = 1 := by omega
  have hs : ∑ i, lengths i = 2 * t := by omega
  have hexpand :
      ∑ i, lengths i = (∑ i, (lengths i - 2)) + 2 * t := by
    calc
      ∑ i, lengths i = ∑ i, ((lengths i - 2) + 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact (Nat.sub_add_cancel (htails i)).symm
      _ = (∑ i, (lengths i - 2)) + 2 * t := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  have hzero : ∑ i, (lengths i - 2) = 0 := by omega
  refine ⟨hr, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hsingle : lengths i - 2 ≤ ∑ j, (lengths j - 2) :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le (lengths j - 2))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hi := htails i
  omega

def partner {P : Type*} (x : P × Bool) : P × Bool :=
  (x.1, !x.2)

theorem partner_involutive {P : Type*} (x : P × Bool) :
    partner (partner x) = x := by
  cases x with
  | mk p b => cases b <;> rfl

theorem partner_ne {P : Type*} (x : P × Bool) : partner x ≠ x := by
  cases x with
  | mk p b => cases b <;> simp [partner]

theorem pool_label_forces_partner {P V : Type*}
    (tag : P → V) (htag : Function.Injective tag)
    (f : P × Bool → P × Bool)
    (hnofix : ∀ x, f x ≠ x)
    (hsupport : ∀ x, tag (f x).1 = tag x.1) :
    f = partner := by
  funext x
  have hp : (f x).1 = x.1 := htag (hsupport x)
  have hb : (f x).2 ≠ x.2 := by
    intro h
    exact hnofix x (Prod.ext hp h)
  change f x = (x.1, !x.2)
  apply Prod.ext hp
  cases hleft : (f x).2 <;> cases hright : x.2 <;> simp_all

theorem pool_assignment_injective {P A : Type*} (a : P → A) :
    Function.Injective (fun p => (p, a p)) := by
  intro p q h
  exact congrArg Prod.fst h

theorem pairing_support_product {P V : Type*}
    [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [DecidableEq V]
    (tag : P → V) (htag : Function.Injective tag)
    (f : P × Bool → P × Bool) (hnofix : ∀ x, f x ≠ x) :
    (∏ x : P × Bool, if tag x.1 = tag (f x).1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) =
      if f = partner then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases h : f = partner
  · subst f
    simp [partner]
  · have hnot : ¬ ∀ x, tag x.1 = tag (f x).1 := by
      intro hs
      exact h (pool_label_forces_partner tag htag f hnofix
        (fun x => (hs x).symm))
    push_neg at hnot
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hnot
    rw [if_neg h]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ x) (by simp [hx])

theorem independent_pool_count (s t M : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card ((Fin s → Fin M) × (Fin t → Fin M)) = M ^ (s + t) := by
  simp [pow_add]

theorem nat_pow_ge (N r : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ r := by
  have hNreal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hNnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N := by positivity
  cases r with
  | zero => omega
  | succ s =>
    have hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ s := by
      induction s with
      | zero => simp
      | succ s ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih hNnonneg
        nlinarith
    calc
      (N : ℝ) = 1 * N := by ring
      _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ s * N := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp hNnonneg
      _ = (N : ℝ) ^ (s + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm

theorem unbounded_power_zero (a C : ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (sizes : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hunbounded : ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ j, B ≤ sizes j)
    (hbound : ∀ j, a * (sizes j : ℝ) ^ r ≤ C) :
    a = 0 := by
  by_contra hne
  have hapos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm hne)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (1 : ℝ) (C / a))
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hunbounded N
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hN
    exact_mod_cast this.le
  have hsize : 1 ≤ sizes j := le_trans hN1 hj
  have hratio : C / a < (sizes j : ℝ) := by
    have hsmall : C / a < (N : ℝ) :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hN
    have hlarge : (N : ℝ) ≤ sizes j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hsmall hlarge
  have htoo : C < (sizes j : ℝ) * a := (div_lt_iff₀ hapos).mp hratio
  have hp := nat_pow_ge (sizes j) r hsize hr
  have hlow := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp ha
  have hu := hbound j
  nlinarith

theorem complex_coefficient_zero (coefficient : ℂ) (C : ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (sizes : ℕ → ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hunbounded : ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ j, B ≤ sizes j)
    (hbound : ∀ j, ‖coefficient‖ ^ 2 * (sizes j : ℝ) ^ r ≤ C ^ 2) :
    coefficient = 0 := by
  have hz : ‖coefficient‖ ^ 2 = 0 :=
    unbounded_power_zero (‖coefficient‖ ^ 2) (C ^ 2) r sizes
      (sq_nonneg _) hr hunbounded hbound
  have hn := norm_nonneg coefficient
  have hnorm : ‖coefficient‖ = 0 := by nlinarith
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm

theorem same_side_coefficient_zero (coefficient : ℂ) (C : ℝ) (s t : ℕ)
    (hpositive : 0 < s + t)
    (hbound : ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ M →
      ‖coefficient‖ ^ 2 * (M : ℝ) ^ (s + t) ≤ C ^ 2) :
    coefficient = 0 := by
  apply complex_coefficient_zero coefficient C (s + t) (fun j => j + 1)
    hpositive
  · intro B
    exact ⟨B, by omega⟩
  · intro j
    exact hbound (j + 1) (by omega)

def crossSideEquiv {I : Type*} (q : I → I)
    (hinv : ∀ i, q (q i) = i) (side : I → Bool)
    (hcross : ∀ i, side (q i) = !side i) :
    {i // side i = false} ≃ {i // side i = true} where
  toFun x := ⟨q x, by rw [hcross, x.property]; rfl⟩
  invFun x := ⟨q x, by rw [hcross, x.property]; rfl⟩
  left_inv x := Subtype.ext (hinv x)
  right_inv x := Subtype.ext (hinv x)

theorem cross_pairing_cardinality {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (q : I → I) (hinv : ∀ i, q (q i) = i) (side : I → Bool)
    (hcross : ∀ i, side (q i) = !side i) :
    Fintype.card {i // side i = false} =
      Fintype.card {i // side i = true} := by
  exact Fintype.card_congr (crossSideEquiv q hinv side hcross)

end InvariantIntertwiners

    hpositive
  · intro B
    exact ⟨B, by omega⟩
  · intro j
    exact hbound (j + 1) (by omega)

def crossSideEquiv {I : Type*} (q : I → I)
    (hinv : ∀ i, q (q i) = i) (side : I → Bool)
    (hcross : ∀ i, side (q i) = !side i) :
    {i // side i = false} ≃ {i // side i = true} where
  toFun x := ⟨q x, by rw [hcross, x.property]; rfl⟩
  invFun x := ⟨q x, by rw [hcross, x.property]; rfl⟩
  left_inv x := Subtype.ext (hinv x)
  right_inv x := Subtype.ext (hinv x)

theorem cross_pairing_cardinality {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (q : I → I) (hinv : ∀ i, q (q i) = i) (side : I → Bool)
    (hcross : ∀ i, side (q i) = !side i) :
    Fintype.card {i // side i = false} =
      Fintype.card {i // side i = true} := by
  exact Fintype.card_congr (crossSideEquiv q hinv side hcross)

end InvariantIntertwiners

claims.natural_statement: For every p>=1 and m>=p, the complex multilinear forms on M_m(C)^p invariant under simultaneous unitary conjugation have the cycle-trace forms Phi_pi as a basis. For all m their span suffices. The normalization is the normalized trace.

retired_assumptions.reason: The independent proof in research/invariant-intertwiners/proof.md Section 3 proves the needed finite commutant theorem, its m=p independence boundary, and the all-m span statement by explicit weight, polarization, and finite double-commutant arguments; the literature theorem is no longer an unproved premise.

routes.retired_because: Finite-stage invariant polynomials include long trace cycles and same-side contractions; finite-dimensional agreement does not imply Hilbert-tensor boundedness or degree preservation. Stable coefficients, unbounded sizes, and orthonormal-pool elimination are indispensable.

Nessonov arxiv:1312.0824v1 Theorem 1(1) concerns left and right multiplication on separate tensor factors, not simultaneous conjugation on centered L2 tensor powers; its hypotheses and representation do not match this route.
